**Test build** of Nexo v0.4 beta: the new native capture engine for streaming games on Windows. Only
friends who install it by hand get it; everyone else stays on the regular releases.

What's in it: see the [v0.4.0-beta.1 notes](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/beta/native-media/.github/release-notes/v0.4.0-beta.1.md).
In short: streams that stay smooth while a game keeps your GPU busy, game audio without the voice chat,
and Nexo hidden from screen shares.

## Please try

- **Stream a game you play uncapped** for a while (Windows). Tell us the fps your stream shows in the
  voice panel, and whether viewers saw it smooth.
- **Turn on audio** when you share: viewers should hear the game, never the voice chat.
- **Share a whole screen** too: Nexo's own window shouldn't show up in it.
- If your stream ever says it switched to Chromium, or ends by itself, tell us what you were doing.
- AMD and Intel graphics especially welcome: so far it has only been tested on NVIDIA.

## Install

Download `Nexo-Setup-0.4.0-test.1.exe` from the **Assets** below and run it over your current Nexo. Your
settings and login stay. SmartScreen may warn: **More info → Run anyway**.

From now on you get new test builds automatically. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
